unavailable historical owners keep their rank and ranked members have no roster Remove
409 requires read-back and a fresh deliberate versioned save, never automatic retry

wordmark and workspace modes stay in the canonical shared application
deep links restore combined filters and legacy layout; clearing preserves chosen presentation
real fields drive search/status/sector/known unassigned; no matching results has a clear recovery
loading and list failure expose retry without rendering a successful empty list

permission and expired-session errors remain explicit and disable profile creation
mobile dark cards and chooser fit viewport; empty portfolio and unsupported sort stay truthful

name, recent, filters and list presentation never persist a subset or overwrite saved order
saved order is not requested against an unloaded catalog

profile notes reject another client's receipt and require review before retry
profile notes retain a refused draft without reporting it saved
late notes receipts cannot close a replacement actor's editor
failed account-team refresh conceals cached members and disables changes
failed member options cannot submit a retained selection
team add needs the requested native roster effect
owner assignment rejects a different returned owner

a removed facility selection does not reopen when that ID returns
unknown facility creation stays fenced after closing and reopening
